caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of woven fabric with a plaid pattern, primarily composed of shades of brown, beige, and various intensities of red and pink. The plaid consists of crisscrossed horizontal and vertical bands, some darker and others lighter, forming rectangular and square shapes throughout the fabric. The arrangement features the most prominent lines and blocks near the center, where the pink and red are more concentrated. The fabric has fringed edges on three visible sides, with strands of thread extending outward, varying slightly in length and color from light beige to reddish-brown, including hints of pink. The texture of the fabric and the weave pattern are visible throughout the piece. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color, contrasting with the fabric sample and highlighting its colors and texture.
title: Shawl (Plaid)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
